description: Create editable solar map placards from customer PDFs using ordered-size zones, source-confirmed warnings, compact callouts, production cutlines and footer identifiers.

interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this customer drawing into an editable solar site SVG, preserving its buildings, panels, equipment, and north.
interface.longDescription: Upload a customer PDF in a file-capable ChatGPT Work or Codex chat and receive a WO-named editable solar SVG. Starts with the confirmed sales-order item and dimensions, then plans zones for the warning, map and compact callouts, lower operational notes and footer. Includes measured production cutline profiles, exact source warning wording and item-specific part identifiers. Preserves the saved map stroke weights, main-structure alignment, compensated north symbol, Illustrator Arrow 2 shapes, equipment mounting and visible arrow gaps. Multiple maps retain their individual physical sizes on one labeled artboard. Includes portable attachment staging, content-hash caching, session-local dependency setup and a Python renderer. Uses host-provided Python 3.10+ with PyMuPDF and Pillow; no model API key, separate app, shared drive or rendering server is required. A chat without Python/file execution or package access cannot run the renderer. Source interpretation, tracing, callout placement and visual review remain agent-assisted. Unconfirmed production sizes, warning conflicts and requested hole patterns are flagged rather than guessed.

name: solar-map-drawing
